0022600175.text: The Boston Celtics (5-1) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-5) in Boston's eighth game of the season, with the Celtics on a five-game winning streak, 2nd in the Atlantic and 1 game back, and 3rd in the East. Milwaukee has lost two straight, sits 13th in the East and 4th in the Central, 4.5 games back, and is 0-2 on the road this season. Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 133-101 win in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
